heading: Nonappropriated fund instrumentalities: furnishing utility services for morale, welfare, and recreation purposes
lead: Appropriations for the Department of Defense may be used to provide utility services for—

tree.text: buildings on military installations authorized by regulation to be used for morale, welfare, and recreation purposes; and
other morale, welfare, and recreation activities for members of the armed forces.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 2494 was renumbered section 2491 of this title.
